Accessors for SingleCellExposomeExperiment objects

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/methods.R
SCEE-accessors.Rd

Get and set the donor-level exposure data of a SingleCellExposomeExperiment and the column of colData that links cells to donors.

Usage

exposureData(x)

exposureInfo(x)

cellSampleMap(x)

sampleColumn(x)

sampleColumn(x) <- value

exposureVariables(x)

exposureData(x) <- value

exposureInfo(x) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
exposureData(x)

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
exposureInfo(x)

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
cellSampleMap(x)

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
sampleColumn(x)

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
sampleColumn(x) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
exposureVariables(x)

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
exposureData(x) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExposomeExperiment'
exposureInfo(x) <- value

Arguments

x

A SingleCellExposomeExperiment.

value

For exposureData<-, a numeric matrix with one row per sample, named by sample ID, and one column per exposure; the rows of exposureInfo(x) follow the new columns, so an exposure can be added (its metadata row is filled with NA), dropped or reordered. For exposureInfo<-, a DataFrame whose exposure column equals colnames(exposureData(x)); for sampleColumn<-, the name of a colData column whose sample IDs match the rows of exposureData(x).

Value

exposureData()

Numeric matrix, samples by exposures.

exposureInfo()

DataFrame with one row per exposure.

exposureVariables()

Character vector of exposure names.

sampleColumn()

Character scalar: the colData column holding each cell's sample (donor) ID. The analysis functions read each cell's donor from this column.

cellSampleMap()

DataFrame with columns cell_id (the cell names) and sample_id, derived from that column.

Replacement functions

The modified object, after a validity check.

counts <- matrix(1L, nrow = 5, ncol = 12,
    dimnames = list(paste0("G", 1:5), paste0("c", 1:12)))
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
        cell_id = paste0("c", 1:12),
        donor_id = rep(paste0("D", 1:4), each = 3)))
exp_mat <- matrix(c(12, 25, 8, 30, 45, 32, 67, 51), nrow = 4,
    dimnames = list(paste0("D", 1:4), c("PM2.5", "age")))
scee <- build_scee(sce, exp_mat, sample_col = "donor_id")

exposureVariables(scee)
#> [1] "PM2.5" "age"  
exposureData(scee)
#>    PM2.5 age
#> D1    12  45
#> D2    25  32
#> D3     8  67
#> D4    30  51
exposureInfo(scee)
#> DataFrame with 2 rows and 3 columns
#>      exposure      family        unit
#>   <character> <character> <character>
#> 1       PM2.5          NA          NA
#> 2         age          NA          NA
sampleColumn(scee)
#> [1] "donor_id"
head(cellSampleMap(scee))
#> DataFrame with 6 rows and 2 columns
#>       cell_id   sample_id
#>   <character> <character>
#> 1          c1          D1
#> 2          c2          D1
#> 3          c3          D1
#> 4          c4          D2
#> 5          c5          D2
#> 6          c6          D2

## Replace the exposure matrix, here rescaling PM2.5
exp_new <- exposureData(scee)
exp_new[, "PM2.5"] <- exp_new[, "PM2.5"] / 10
exposureData(scee) <- exp_new
exposureData(scee)[, "PM2.5"]
#>  D1  D2  D3  D4 
#> 1.2 2.5 0.8 3.0
